title: The Imperfective Paradox Is Not Necessarily in Large Language Models: A Benchmark Failure Before a Model Failure
abstract: arXiv:2608.25005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The imperfective paradox provides a useful test of compositional semantic analysis. Recent work constructs an NLI benchmark and reports that models frequently infer completed telic events from progressive descriptions, attributing this behavior to a Teleological Bias. It further argues that prompting interventions cause a Calibration Crisis. We reexamine the benchmark and conclusions and show that it is substantially affected by conceptual and evaluation mis-specifications. We identify three conceptual mis-specifications. In particular, Aspectual Reduction affects the benchmark construction, analysis, experiments, and conclusions. Under a strict NLI standard, 76% of Group A instances do not explicitly rule out culmination. In our native-speaker annotation, 38% of Group A examples and 29% of the Group C examples were judged to permit an alternative interpretation. To control these issues and lexical variation, we construct Lexically Match

translated_title: 不完全性悖论未必存在于大型语言模型中：模型失败之前的基准失败
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25005v1 公告类型：新 摘要：不完全性悖论为组合语义分析提供了一个有用的测试。近期研究构建了一个NLI基准，并报告模型经常从进行体描述中推断出完成的终结事件，将此行为归因于“目的论偏差”。该研究进一步声称，提示干预会导致“校准危机”。我们重新审视了该基准和结论，并表明其受到概念性和评估性错误规范的显著影响。我们识别出三个概念性错误规范。特别是，“体貌缩减”影响了基准构建、分析、实验和结论。在严格的NLI标准下，A组实例中有76%并未明确排除终结性。在我们的母语者标注中，A组示例的38%和C组示例的29%被认为允许替代解释。为控制这些问题和词汇变异，我们构建了“词汇匹配”...
tldr: 本文指出现有NLI基准因概念和评估错误规范（如体貌缩减）而失效，导致大型语言模型在“不完全性悖论”测试中的表现被误判，并提出了改进的词汇匹配基准。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that existing NLI benchmarks fail due to conceptual and evaluation mis-specifications (e.g., aspectual reduction), leading to misjudged LLM performance on the imperfective paradox, and proposes a lexically matched benchmark.
